name: Magnus Ladulås
contribution: King of Sweden from 1275 until his death in 1290.
legacy: In The Cambridge History of Scandinavia, historian Herman Schück describes this person's reign as having been regarded by his near contemporaries as a period of revolutionary significance.

checks.lead: Magnus Ladulås (pronounced ['lɑːdɵloːs], lit. 'Barnlock'), also known as Magnus Birgersson (c. 1240 – 18 December 1290), was King of Sweden from 1275 until his death in 1290.
